title: Investor Inattention and Friday Earnings Announcements
one_line: Friday earnings announcements get a ~15% smaller immediate reaction, ~70% more drift and ~8% less volume than other days (1984-2006) — evidence that inattention drives PEAD.

findings.statement: Immediate response −15%, drift +70%, volume −8% on Fridays.

reported_results.headline: Friday earnings announcements get a ~15% smaller immediate reaction, ~70% more drift and ~8% less volume than other days (1984-2006) — evidence that inattention drives PEAD.

tradable_edge: Stock-level; PEAD has since disappeared for large caps (Martineau).
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
